race.description: Rodney Lees Cabinetmaking Lismore Cup Hcp (C3)
race.comment: GORBACHEV (6) led for home but couldn't hold off FUKUBANA last start over 1400m at Eagle Farm. Will race handy again and the slightly longer trip shouldn't concern him. Sure to run them along and gets his chance to turn the tables. Stablemate FUKUBANA (2) is the obvious danger after a mighty effort to score with a bit in hand under 60.5kgs in Brisbane last time. Goes up to 62kgs and might need luck slotting in from a wide draw but has a big class edge on this field. CARRAVILLA (8) raced handy then went home well but found one better in a BM78 over 1400m at the Gold Coast recently. Plummets in the weights after McColm's claim. Will go forward and prove tough to hold out. GIAPPONESE (12) was shuffled back mid-race then came again to grab second last start over the mile at Eagle Farm. Jai Williams has won three from four on the entire and he is back in the irons. One to consider. MICKEY'S MEDAL (3) finished just two lengths from the airborne The Mona Lisa last time which is solid form.
